1.

By this petition, the petitioners seek a direction to the respondents to pay the remaining arrears of 20% award amount instantly alongwith 24% interest thereon per annum from the date of Final Award, till the realisation of compensation amount to the petitioner Nos.1 to 8.
2.

It appears that the respondents initiated acquisition proceedings in 1995 and that the respondent No.2-Special Land Acquisition Officer No.4, Karmala have made a declaration under Sections 4 and 6 in the local newspapers.

entities.text: Special Land Acquisition Officer No.4, Karmala
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text:
In the said publication,
907-wp.1484.2022.doc apart from the name of the several others, name of the petitioner Nos.1 to 8 were included.

It appears that although the name of the petitioner No.9 was not included in the local newspapers, the respondents approached the petitioner No.9 and the petitioner No.9 handed over the land to the respondents.
Thereafter the respondent Nos.3 and 4 requested the petitioners for physical possesion of the lands and accordingly the petitioners handed over their lands to the respondent No.3 and 4.

It further appears that after possession of the said lands, the respondent Nos.3 and 4 only paid 80% of the compensation amount out of the total amount to the pettioner Nos. 1 to 8 in 2007 and the balance 20% is kept due till today, without any reason.
It also appears that the petitioner No.9 has not received a single farthing, till date.
Hence, this petition.
3. Learned A.G.P. has tendered a letter dated 29 th July 2025 addressed by them to the Railway Authorities i.e. respondent Nos.3 and 4.

The said letter is taken on record Hanumant Narayan Mane And Ors vs State Of Maharashtra Thr. District ... on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155201123/
2 and a copy thereof is served on the learned counsel for the petitioners.

entities.text: Hanumant Narayan Mane And Ors vs State Of Maharashtra Thr. District
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: To the letter is annexed a 907-wp.1484.2022.doc list of persons to whom part compensation is paid and what amount is due and payable.

4. Learned counsel for the respondent Nos.3 and 4 on instructions states that the Railway Authorities will deposit the money alongwith interest with the Special Land Acquisition Officer, within two months from today, as reflected in the letter dated 29 th July 2025.
Statement accepted.
5. On depositing the said amount within two months from today, the Special Land Acquisition Officer, to disburse the said amount to the parties concerned, within four weeks thereafter.
6. Petition is accordingly disposed of on the aforesaid terms.

7. We make it clear that we have not gone into the calculations made by the authorities and as such keep all contentions of all parties open on merits vis-a-vis the calculations made by the authorities.
We expect the Railway Authorities i.e. respondent Nos.3 and 4 and the Special Land Acquisition Officer, to abide by the order passed today.
All concerned to act on the authenticated copy of this order.

DR. NEELA GOKHALE, J. REVATI MOHITE DERE, J.
